'''Hangar Bay 7''' was the smaller of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bays]]. The hangar housed two [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] as well as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and was located on the north side of the base.<ref name="Strongholds" />
